name: vibe2spec
description: Turn developer and researcher requests into approved specifications, reviewed work, and reproducible results.

interface.longDescription: Clarify a development or research goal through an active interview. Approve one complete step at a time, review specifications and actual work in separate contexts, and verify outputs against explicit comparison rules. Includes local Node.js helpers and small paired-function checks. Execution control is instruction-based and requires user decisions and independent review.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn my project idea into a precise specification.
Resume my project from its saved Vibe2Spec records.
